title: E2EE transcription-assisted low-bandwidth speech with participant-trained personalized reconstruction models
goal: Extend Ananta Pair-Dev voice communication with two optional negotiated modes: (1) transcription-assisted speech transport that sends immediate text, timing and bounded acoustic features while delayed encrypted source audio corrects reconstruction; and (2) consent-bound personalized model learning where aligned transcript plus later source audio becomes curated training evidence for a model specialized to the current speaker-listener pair. Participants negotiate compute, latency, privacy, trainer and validator roles through deterministic contracts surfaced by AI-Snake.

codebase_alignment.voice_runtime: voice_runtime/ is already the separate audio runtime. docs/voice-runtime-hybrid-transcription.md defines simple, oldschool_light, whisper_cpp, realtime_streaming, meeting, confidence_rerun and custom pipelines plus Vosk, whisper.cpp and Voxtral adapters.
codebase_alignment.voice_contract: voice_runtime/schemas.py already exposes versioned transcription results with segments, words, confidence, candidates, disagreement regions, decision_trace and provenance. Extend this contract additively instead of inventing an unrelated transcript format.
codebase_alignment.voice_policy_boundary: The Hub remains the policy and exposure boundary; raw audio storage is fail-closed through VOICE_STORE_AUDIO. Real-time audio processing must stay outside the Hub control plane.
codebase_alignment.pair_transport: docs/architecture/pair-view-sync.md already supports encrypted WebRTC DataChannel with opaque Hub Relay fallback, default-deny permissions, sequence/hash recovery and bounded envelopes.
codebase_alignment.semantic_media_parent: todos/todo.ai-snake-distributed-webrtc-semantic-stream.json already plans participant capabilities, signed compute-quality contracts, task-scoped leases, validators, epochs, replay protection and AI-Snake negotiation. Reuse those contracts and avoid a second master-election system.
codebase_alignment.ml_intern: docs/ml-intern-lora-finetuning.md and agent/services/ml_intern_* already provide curated dataset ingestion, validation, deterministic splitting, isolated LoRA/QLoRA workers, evaluation, approval, registry lifecycle, inference routing and rollback.
codebase_alignment.ml_intern_constraint: Current ML-Intern explicitly forbids automatic ingestion of chat or voice usage data and does not support worker-to-worker orchestration or automatic adapter approval. This feature must preserve those boundaries unless a new explicit consent and curation path is implemented.
known_gaps: No typed low-bandwidth speech envelope currently combines transcript, word timing, prosody hints, acoustic residuals and delayed source-audio references.
No pair-scoped speaker adaptation dataset contract exists.
No supported path converts voice-runtime provenance into ML-Intern curated records.
Current LoRA pipeline targets text-model behavior; speech reconstruction may require speaker embeddings, acoustic adapters or a separate audio-model backend rather than reusing text LoRA blindly.
Pair-View is currently n=2 and its permission set does not include voice reconstruction, speaker adaptation, training contribution or voice-model export.

A transcript plus delayed audio is high-quality aligned evidence, but not automatically perfect ground truth: ASR mistakes, timing drift, overlapping speech, noise and emotional/prosodic ambiguity must be measured and filtered.

principles: Both modes are optional and disabled by default.
Ordinary encrypted WebRTC audio remains the compatibility and safety fallback.
Immediate intelligibility and conversational turn-taking take priority over voice similarity.
Text, urgent speech events and interruption markers must not wait for the configured delayed-audio window.
The configurable delay may be negotiated per participant and per direction; one slow listener must not slow every participant.
AI-Snake explains and proposes. Deterministic policy validates consent, contracts, keys, leases, datasets and model activation.
No participant voice is trained, cloned, exported or retained without explicit purpose-scoped consent.
Voice identity data is biometric-sensitive derived data and receives stronger defaults than ordinary transcript data.
Transcript/audio alignment is training evidence, not presumed perfect truth. Quality gates decide whether a segment is admitted.
Server/SFU processing is optional and separately consented; strict E2EE keeps plaintext audio, transcript and acoustic features participant-side.
Training and inference budgets are bounded by CPU/GPU/NPU, battery, thermal, network and latency limits.
Every personalized model has provenance, owner/pair scope, expiry, revocation, evaluation and rollback.

transcription_assisted_transport.summary: Transmit live transcript plus timing, punctuation, speaker-turn and bounded prosody/acoustic hints immediately. The receiver renders text and optionally reconstructs intelligible provisional speech locally. Delayed encrypted source audio or residual corrections arrive later and replace or correct uncertain regions.

personalized_pair_learning.summary: Use consented transcript/source-audio alignment and reconstruction errors as curated pair-scoped training evidence. Train or adapt a receiver-local or trusted participant-local speech model so future provisional reconstruction better matches the speaker while retaining delayed-source correction and ordinary-audio fallback.
personalized_pair_learning.activation: explicit opt-in plus evaluation and approval
personalized_pair_learning.fallback: generic local speech model or standard encrypted WebRTC audio

non_goals: Do not claim lossless, perfect or indistinguishable voice reproduction.
Do not silently create a reusable voice clone from calls.
Do not upload raw audio to ML-Intern merely because a session used transcription.
Do not use text-model LoRA as a substitute for an acoustic or speech-synthesis adaptation backend without demonstrated compatibility.
Do not allow the SFU or Hub to decrypt strict-E2EE speech payloads.
Do not let an LLM approve datasets, issue cryptographic grants or activate personalized models.
Do not let personalized reconstruction fabricate words absent from the authoritative transcript or source-audio correction.
Do not make personalized model availability a prerequisite for joining a call.
target_data_flow: Fast local or negotiated ASR candidate generation
Immediate transcript/timing/turn envelope over prioritized encrypted DataChannel
Optional local provisional speech synthesis using generic or pair-personalized model
Delayed encrypted Opus/source segment and/or bounded acoustic residual
Receiver alignment, correction and reconstruction-error measurement
Consent and quality filtering into an ephemeral evidence buffer
Explicit curation into ML-Intern-compatible immutable dataset artifacts
Pair-scoped adapter approval and receiver-local inference routing
Continuous quality monitoring, rollback and ordinary WebRTC fallback

training_evidence: minimum speech duration and usable voiced ratio
ASR confidence threshold plus disagreement-region review
consent valid at capture, curation and training time
exact and near-duplicate grouping before train/validation split
held-out sessions or time windows prevent leakage
model_activation: intelligibility does not regress against generic baseline
word-error hallucination rate remains below policy threshold
speaker similarity improves only on consented evaluation samples
latency, real-time factor, memory and energy budgets pass
cross-speaker leakage and memorization probes pass
rollback artifact and generic fallback are available

milestones.exit: Versioned schemas, biometric-data policy and deterministic state machines approved.

milestones.title: Transcript-first transport
milestones.exit: Two peers receive prioritized live transcript and delayed encrypted audio correction with safe fallback.

milestones.title: Generic provisional speech
milestones.exit: Receiver can locally render provisional intelligible speech without altering authoritative words.

tasks.title: Define speech-specific threat model, consent model and legal data classes
tasks.description: Document strict-E2EE, trusted-peer and optional trusted-server profiles. Treat voice embeddings, speaker adapters and source audio as sensitive biometric-like data. Cover impersonation, voice cloning, replay, dataset poisoning, malicious transcripts, model inversion, memorization, coercive consent and post-revocation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Trust boundaries for microphone, browser, peer trainer, validator, Hub, SFU, TURN, voice runtime and ML worker are explicit.
Capture, transport, ephemeral buffering, curation, training, inference, export and deletion have separate consent decisions.
All new permissions default to deny and are direction-specific.
Revocation semantics define whether evidence, datasets, adapters and caches are deleted, disabled or retained for audit.
Voice impersonation and unauthorized export are explicit abuse cases with prevention, detection and recovery.
AI-Snake and LLM output are non-authoritative for consent, keys and activation.

tasks.title: Specify the two negotiated speech modes and fallback state machine
tasks.description: Define disabled, standard_audio, transcript_assisted, transcript_plus_provisional_speech, personalized_learning_shadow, personalized_active, degraded and fallback states with deterministic transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Identical ordered events produce identical states and reason codes.
Mode can differ independently in each call direction.
Delay is bounded from 0 to 20000 ms and may be renegotiated without restarting the call.
Urgent transcript, interruption and end-of-turn events bypass delayed-audio buffering.
Any timeout, integrity failure, confidence collapse or revoked consent returns to standard encrypted audio.
Legacy peers remain in standard_audio without errors.

tasks.title: Create versioned semantic-speech JSON Schemas
tasks.description: Add bounded schemas with strict required fields, identifiers, epochs, sequences, expiry, hashes, signatures and privacy scopes.
acceptance_criteria: Security-sensitive schemas reject unknown properties where forward compatibility does not require them.
Text, words, feature vectors, residual references and metadata have explicit size/count bounds.
No schema embeds unbounded raw audio or private keys.
Consent purpose and retention are machine-readable rather than free text only.
Fixtures cover valid, stale, replayed, malformed, oversized and revoked messages.
Python and TypeScript validators pass the same conformance corpus.

tasks.title: Extend Pair-Dev permissions for speech reconstruction and training
tasks.description: Add default-deny permissions for transcript transport, provisional speech reconstruction, delayed audio correction, training evidence capture, local training, trusted-peer training, trusted-server training and adapter export.
acceptance_criteria: Existing permission keys and old clients remain compatible.
Each new permission defaults to false and implies no other permission.
Training permission is bound to speaker, listener, purpose, model class, storage location and retention.
Export and server-side training require separate explicit grants.
Revocation invalidates active leases and prevents admission of newly arriving evidence.
Frontend and backend share canonical permission names and tests.

tasks.title: Add semantic speech fields to Voice Runtime result contracts
tasks.description: Extend the existing transcription-result v2 model additively with stable transcript revisions, end-of-turn status, authoritative-content flags, alignment quality, speaker-turn identity, acoustic-feature provenance and delayed-source references.
acceptance_criteria: Existing text, segments, words, candidates, disagreement_regions, decision_trace and provenance remain valid.
Every provisional transcript has a revision and can be superseded deterministically.
Word and segment timing remains monotonic and bounded by source duration.
Authoritative transcript/source status is distinguishable from provisional ASR output.
Synthetic and reconstructed audio is marked unambiguously in provenance.
Old result payloads deserialize without migration.

tasks.title: Implement streaming transcript revision and turn-detection pipeline
tasks.description: Complete the prepared realtime_streaming path with partial/final transcript revisions, VAD, turn boundaries, candidate fusion and bounded confidence reruns.
acceptance_criteria: Partial transcript latency and finalization latency are measured separately.
Out-of-order and duplicate backend updates are deduplicated.
Confidence reruns affect only bounded uncertain regions.
Speaker overlap and unclear end-of-turn state are surfaced rather than hidden.
Pipeline works with optional Vosk, whisper.cpp and Voxtral availability and deterministic mock fixtures.
Backpressure prevents unlimited queued audio.

tasks.title: Define bounded prosody and acoustic-residual feature extractors
tasks.description: Create replaceable feature extractors for pitch contour, energy, duration, speaking rate, pause structure and optional bounded residuals. Do not transmit raw reusable speaker embeddings by default.
acceptance_criteria: Feature contracts are versioned, quantized and size bounded.
Features can be disabled independently and are covered by explicit consent.
No extractor blocks the real-time transcript path.
Missing pitch, noise and unvoiced regions have explicit representations.
Privacy review distinguishes expressive prosody from persistent speaker identity features.
Deterministic fixtures verify encoding and decoding tolerances.

tasks.title: Implement prioritized E2EE semantic-speech DataChannel transport
tasks.description: Carry transcript revisions, turns, feature envelopes, delayed-audio references and corrections over encrypted DataChannel with opaque Hub Relay fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Transcript and interruption messages have priority over acoustic residuals and delayed audio metadata.
Per-kind byte, rate, queue and TTL limits apply before expensive parsing.
DataChannel bufferedAmount triggers degradation instead of memory growth.
Epoch, sequence, expiry and signatures prevent replay and stale correction.
Hub Relay never requires plaintext transcript, voice features or source audio.
Transport failure automatically selects standard encrypted WebRTC audio.

tasks.title: Implement delayed encrypted source-audio ring buffer and correction path
tasks.description: Buffer bounded encrypted Opus/source segments for 0-20 seconds, then deliver them as authoritative correction or discard them according to contract and observed quality.
acceptance_criteria: Buffer duration and byte budget are enforced independently.
Source segments are encrypted end-to-end and never persisted by default.
Transcript/source alignment uses monotonic timestamps and stream epochs.
Late, missing or corrupt segments produce explicit recovery or fallback reason codes.
Receiver may replace provisional speech without replaying an entire long segment.
Closing, revoking or leaving a session wipes ephemeral buffers.

tasks.title: Add transcript-first low-bandwidth receiver UI
tasks.description: Show live provisional/final transcript, current delay, reconstruction status, correction state, confidence and fallback without overwhelming the user.
acceptance_criteria: Provisional and authoritative text are visually distinguishable.
User can set a per-peer maximum delay between 0 and 20 seconds within contract limits.
User can disable reconstruction or training immediately.
UI shows whether current audio is original, provisional synthetic, corrected or fallback.
Accessibility supports captions without requiring synthesized audio.
No hidden toggle grants training or export consent.

tasks.title: Create pluggable provisional speech reconstruction interface
tasks.description: Define generic browser-local or participant-local synthesis from authoritative transcript plus timing/prosody hints, with adapters for future personalized models.
acceptance_criteria: The reconstructor cannot add lexical content not present in the selected transcript revision.
Synthesis cancellation reacts to transcript correction and interruption.
Generic fallback voice works without a personalized adapter.
Latency, real-time factor, memory and queue depth are measured.
Output is always marked synthetic in local state and provenance.
Unavailable browser APIs degrade to captions or ordinary audio.

tasks.title: Build transcript/source alignment and reconstruction-error metrics
tasks.description: Align transcript revisions, provisional synthesis and delayed source audio at word/segment level. Produce quality metrics suitable for correction, evidence admission and model evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: Alignment reports uncertainty and does not force matches across gaps or overlapping speakers.
Metrics include transcript disagreement, timing error, missing/extra lexical content, voiced coverage and acoustic similarity proxies.
Metric definitions are model-independent and versioned.
No single similarity score is treated as proof of speaker identity or quality.
Synthetic fixtures cover drift, packet loss, noise, corrections and speaker overlap.
Metrics contain no raw audio and are safe for bounded audit events.

tasks.title: Implement ephemeral consent-bound speech training evidence buffer
tasks.description: Collect aligned source audio, stabilized transcript and metrics in an encrypted ephemeral buffer only when a valid speaker-training consent exists.
acceptance_criteria: No valid consent means no training evidence object is created.
Evidence is scoped to exact speaker, listener, session/pair purpose and allowed trainer location.
Admission rejects low-confidence transcript, alignment drift, clipping, overlap and excessive noise.
Rejected evidence is counted by reason without retaining raw content.
Evidence expires automatically unless explicitly curated.
Revocation wipes uncurated buffers and blocks later asynchronous admission.

tasks.title: Create immutable speech dataset manifest and ML-Intern bridge
tasks.description: Convert explicitly curated evidence into immutable content-addressed speech dataset artifacts while preserving the existing ML-Intern rule that voice usage is never automatically training data.
acceptance_criteria: Curation is an explicit authenticated mutation with idempotency and consent checks.
Manifest binds transcript, timing, source digest, feature versions, consent, provenance and quality report.
Raw audio paths never appear in public API responses or logs.
Train/validation splitting groups same session, phrase duplicates and near-duplicate audio to prevent leakage.
Secret/PII scanning and redacted preview extend existing dataset controls.
Existing instruction/chat JSONL datasets and LoRA paths remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Define speech adaptation backend contracts separate from text LoRA
tasks.description: Add a typed backend interface for speaker embeddings, acoustic adapters, decoder/TTS adapters or other supported speech adaptation methods. Reuse ML-Intern orchestration but do not pretend PEFT-TRL text LoRA can train arbitrary speech models.
acceptance_criteria: Backend declares model family, task, required artifact format, hardware, licenses and whether training is speaker- or listener-local.
Unsupported base model/backend combinations fail before queue admission.
Text LoRA and speech adaptation requests are unambiguous and cannot cross-route.
Mock backend supports deterministic CI without real voice cloning.
At least one documented real backend path is selected before live activation work begins.
Worker remains isolated and Hub imports no audio-training framework.

tasks.title: Implement isolated personalized speech training worker
tasks.description: Materialize verified pair-scoped dataset manifests in an isolated worker, execute bounded training/adaptation and emit content-free progress plus typed artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Worker verifies dataset, consent, model and attempt/fencing digests before reading audio.
Training has bounded steps, wall time, memory, disk and checkpoint counts.
Cancel and lease expiry stop work and prevent late artifact publication.
Events contain no transcript or raw audio.
Artifacts are content-addressed and tied to base model and dataset manifest.
Mock end-to-end training runs in CI.

tasks.title: Add personalized speech evaluation and leakage tests
tasks.description: Compare generic baseline and personalized adapter on held-out sessions, unseen text, noise and latency while probing memorization and cross-speaker leakage.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation separates intelligibility, lexical fidelity, timing, prosody, speaker similarity, latency and resource cost.
Personalization cannot pass when lexical hallucination or intelligibility regresses beyond policy.
Held-out data is separated by session/time and duplicate groups.
Cross-speaker and non-consented-speaker probes detect leakage.
Memorization checks test recovery of training phrases or source segments.
Report contains thresholds, confidence intervals or sample counts and explicit limitations.

tasks.title: Add pair-scoped adapter registry, approval, expiry and rollback
tasks.description: Extend existing explicit approval and rollback concepts to speech adapters with speaker/listener scope, consent linkage, expiry and export policy.
acceptance_criteria: No adapter becomes active automatically after training.
Registry entry binds speaker, listener/pair, base model, dataset manifest, evaluation report and artifact digest.
Expired or revoked consent prevents new activation and triggers configured unload/deletion behavior.
Rollback restores the generic or previous approved adapter and clears runtime caches.
Export is impossible unless separately consented and policy-approved.
Public metadata never exposes raw voice samples or local paths.

tasks.title: Implement receiver-local personalized adapter inference
tasks.description: Load an approved pair-scoped adapter only on permitted participant devices and use it for provisional reconstruction under resource and latency budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact digest, pair scope, base-model compatibility, expiry and consent are verified before load.
Adapter never changes transcript lexical content.
Inference timeout or resource pressure falls back to generic reconstruction or standard audio.
Unload wipes model caches according to revocation policy.
Metrics compare personalized and generic paths in shadow mode before activation.
No adapter is shared with another participant or session without an explicit compatible grant.

tasks.title: Extend compute-quality contracts with speech roles
tasks.description: Reuse the parent semantic-WebRTC negotiation system to allocate ASR, feature extraction, provisional synthesis, alignment, validation and optional training tasks among consenting participants or trusted server workers.
acceptance_criteria: Roles are short-lived, direction-specific leases rather than a permanent global master.
A peer cannot receive plaintext or derived voice data outside its consented task scope.
Capacity claims are checked against observed latency, errors and resource behavior.
Training tasks cannot be assigned to a location excluded by speaker consent.
Lease loss, churn or validator disagreement triggers deterministic reassignment or fallback.
Server-side execution is never silently selected in strict-E2EE mode.

tasks.title: Integrate AI-Snake negotiation and explanation UI
tasks.description: Let AI-Snake explain bandwidth, delay, compute, privacy and model-quality tradeoffs, propose contracts and show why roles or fallbacks changed. Deterministic services remain authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: Snake suggestions compile to bounded typed proposals and cannot directly grant consent or activate models.
Users see which peer performs ASR, synthesis, validation or training and for how long.
The 0-20 second delay and bandwidth/quality tradeoff are understandable before acceptance.
New settings are registered through chat_setting_definitions rather than arbitrary config keys.
Negative feedback enters the existing heuristic candidate/shadow/canary/rollback lifecycle.
Audit events contain reason codes without transcript or audio content.

tasks.title: Add adaptive bandwidth, delay and correction controller
tasks.description: Adapt transcript cadence, feature richness, delayed-audio frequency, correction region size and fallback using observed network, ASR, reconstruction and user latency budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Controller optimizes measured quality and bandwidth rather than assuming fixed 90% or 99% savings.
Critical confidence or lexical mismatch sends immediate source correction or standard audio.
Stable personalized performance may lengthen correction intervals only within negotiated limits.
Per-peer policies prevent a weak participant from degrading all listeners.
Hysteresis and minimum dwell times prevent mode oscillation.
Shadow-mode decisions are logged content-free before active rollout.

tasks.title: Create end-to-end, security, chaos and revocation tests
tasks.description: Test two-peer and multi-peer negotiation, E2EE relay opacity, ASR errors, packet loss, delayed corrections, malicious peers, poisoned evidence, trainer failure, consent revocation and adapter rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Plaintext transcript, source audio and identity features never appear in Hub/SFU logs under strict E2EE.
Replay, tampering, oversized envelopes and stale leases are rejected before expensive work.
Revocation during buffering, curation, training and inference each reaches the specified safe state.
Malicious transcript or validator disagreement cannot silently change authoritative words.
Trainer crash, peer disconnect and key rotation recover without using stale artifacts.
All tests verify fallback to ordinary encrypted WebRTC audio.

tasks.title: Benchmark bandwidth, intelligibility, similarity, latency and compute at scale
tasks.description: Measure standard Opus against transcript-only, transcript plus generic reconstruction and transcript plus personalized reconstruction across network, speaker, device and noise profiles, including one speaker to 100 listeners.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes median, p95 and peak bandwidth rather than only averages.
Separate text/control, features, delayed audio, corrections and retransmission traffic.
Quality reports lexical fidelity, intelligibility, timing, speaker similarity, correction frequency and user-visible delay.
Compute reports sender, receiver, peer-trainer and optional server CPU/GPU/NPU, memory, energy and thermal impact.
Scenarios include quiet speech, accents, fast speech, overlap, music/noise, packet loss and model cold start.
No release claim promises a fixed reduction unless supported by reproducible scenario-specific evidence.
Release gate requires ordinary WebRTC fallback capacity even when optimized average bandwidth is much lower.

definition_of_done: Both negotiated modes are implemented behind disabled-by-default feature flags.
A two-peer strict-E2EE call can deliver live transcript, optional provisional speech and delayed source correction without Hub plaintext access.
Training evidence is created only under explicit valid consent and passes alignment, quality, privacy and leakage gates.
ML-Intern can ingest an immutable speech dataset, run an isolated supported adaptation backend, evaluate it, require approval, activate it pair-scoped and roll it back.
AI-Snake can explain and propose contracts but cannot bypass deterministic consent, lease, schema or model-lifecycle enforcement.
Revocation and session exit clear ephemeral buffers and disable or delete artifacts according to policy.
Security and chaos suites pass, including malicious peers, replay, poisoning, trainer failure and key rotation.
Benchmarks publish honest scenario-specific bandwidth, quality, latency and compute results for up to 100 listeners.
Standard encrypted WebRTC audio remains fully functional and capacity-planned as fallback.
